integrity: A complete case proof is supplied. A separately implemented brute-force enumeration checks 66 parameter pairs and 327,696 initial states. The older original threshold paper was available only through its abstract and indexed bibliographic evidence. No independent validation is represented.
scientific_limitations: Exact primitive period-two orbit counts only for labelled cycles with one nonconsecutive chord; no basin sizes, transient times, additional chords or independent priority proof.
title: A single chord activates and enumerates majority two-cycles on odd rings
